scientific_limitations_and_integrity.domain: Finite bouquets of at least two complete blocks with precisely one shared vertex; clique-avoidance arity at least three; all positive private block sizes.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.evidence: An explicit simplicial decomposition, acyclic skeleton matching, vanishing attaching map, natural integral chain algebra, and a reproducible standard-library finite checker of both homology and signed symmetry characters.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.limitations: The result does not classify general block graphs, arbitrary clique sums, block-interchanging automorphisms, simple-homotopy types, or equivariant homotopy types. Bibliographic priority is provisional pending independent literature scrutiny. Finite verification does not prove all sizes.

title: Two-degree sphere splittings and integral symmetry modules for clique bouquets
